test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the word that is similar in meaning (SYNONYM) to the word given below

Glib
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Option 1) Inarticulate: This word means unable to express oneself clearly or fluently. It is the opposite of the meaning of 'glib' which means fluent and voluble but insincere and shallow. Therefore, this option is incorrect.
 
• Option 2) Implausible: This word means not seeming reasonable or probable; failing to convince. It is not a synonym of 'glib'. Therefore, this option is incorrect.
 
• **Option 3) Easy: This word means achieved without great effort; presenting few difficulties. This option is a synonym of 'glib'. Therefore, this option is correct.**
 
• Option 4) Sincere: This word means free from pretence or deceit; proceeding from genuine feelings. It is the opposite of the meaning of 'glib' which means fluent and voluble but insincere and shallow. Therefore, this option is incorrect.

Hence, the correct answer is option 3) Easy.
